evidence_quote: The total revenue from all customers is the same as the total revenue from returns in this case because every returning customer is buying a new book.
question_evidence_quote: 37% of her 1000 customers end up returning their books.  Her books all cost 15 dollars apiece.
observed_error: The response equates total sales revenue with the return amount and introduces unsupported replacement purchases.
violated_condition: Gross sales cover all 1000 customers at $15 each; returns cover only 37% of those customers.
error_description: The response correctly calculates the return amount, then equates it with revenue from all customers, claiming every returning customer buys a new book. The question supplies no replacement purchases: gross revenue must use all 1000 customers at $15 each, while the return amount covers only 370 customers.
secondary_errors: The response reports $5550 as retained sales without performing the stated subtraction; even its own equal gross-sales and returns figures would subtract to zero.
